title: HKEX consults on lowering the 18C market-cap threshold for specialist tech
note: A consultation proposes cutting the minimum market cap for commercial-stage specialist-tech applicants under Chapter 18C to widen the pipeline; comment period runs to September.

title: Hang Seng Index consultation floats a fast-entry rule for mega-IPOs
note: A proposal would fast-track index entry for IPOs above a market-cap threshold, shortening the wait between listing and inclusion.

title: Consumer-robotics unit of a large appliance group said to weigh a Hong Kong spin-off
note: Reported to be exploring a separate listing of its robotics arm; no filing has been made and terms are not set.

title: Overseas fast-fashion group said to revive Hong Kong listing talks
note: Sources suggest the group is reconsidering Hong Kong after a stalled process elsewhere; the company has not commented.
